blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】エンカウント率
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] Encounter Rates

blocks.source: エンカウント率とは？
blocks.translation: What Is an Encounter Rate?

blocks.source: エンカウント率とは敵の出現率のこと。これが高すぎると非常にストレスが溜まるので、ゲームバランスの中でも重要な要素となっている。プレイヤーに楽しんでもらうためには、エンカウント率はどのように調整すればよいだろう？
blocks.translation: An encounter rate is the rate at which enemies appear. If it is too high, it causes considerable stress, making it an important aspect of game balance. How should you adjust the encounter rate to ensure players enjoy the game?

blocks.source: エンカウント率は低めでＯＫ
blocks.translation: It’s Okay to Keep the Encounter Rate Low

blocks.source: 結論から言えば、
blocks.translation: In short,

blocks.source: エンカウント率は低めで良い。
blocks.translation: it is best to keep the encounter rate low.

blocks.source: エンカウント率が高くて、不評なＲＰＧはいくらでも例を挙げられるけれど、エンカウント率が低くて不評なＲＰＧは滅多に聞かない。
blocks.translation: There are countless examples of unpopular RPGs with high encounter rates, but it is rare to hear of an unpopular RPG because its encounter rate is low.

blocks.source: 一応、低すぎた場合の弊害として……
blocks.translation: For completeness, the drawbacks of making it too low include...

blocks.source: サクサク進みすぎて、手応えがなくなる。
blocks.translation: The game progresses too smoothly, making it feel unsatisfying.

blocks.source: プレイ時間が短くなる。
blocks.translation: The playtime becomes shorter.

blocks.source: 経験値稼ぎがやりにくい。
blocks.translation: It becomes difficult to grind for experience.

blocks.source: などが挙げられるが、そもそも上２つは、シナリオ重視のプレイヤーによっては大した弊害ではない。3.に関しては、
blocks.translation: These are some examples, but the first two are not significant drawbacks for some players who prioritize the scenario. As for number 3,

blocks.source: 森などの特定の地形のエンカウント率を上げる。
blocks.translation: Increase the encounter rate in specific terrain, such as forests.

blocks.source: （初代ＤＱからの伝統的な手法）
blocks.translation: (A traditional method dating back to the first Dragon Quest)

blocks.source: 敵の出現率を上げる手段を用意する。
blocks.translation: Provide a way to increase the rate at which enemies appear.

blocks.source: などの対処法が用意できる。
blocks.translation: These are some possible solutions.

blocks.source: 反対にエンカウント率が高い場合の弊害の例。
blocks.translation: By contrast, here are some examples of the drawbacks of a high encounter rate.

blocks.source: 全体的なゲームテンポが悪化する。
blocks.translation: The overall game tempo suffers.

blocks.source: 戦闘が面倒になるため、ボタン連打やオート戦闘を多用するようになる。同様に、戦闘を速く片付けるために、力押しの戦略を取るようになる。結果的に戦闘が単調化して質が落ちる。
blocks.translation: Because battles become tedious, players start relying heavily on button mashing and auto-battle. Similarly, they resort to brute-force strategies to finish battles quickly. As a result, battles become monotonous and lose quality.

blocks.source: 戦闘開始と同時に即「逃げる」ようになる。逃げるだけの戦闘ならば、エンカウントの演出にかかる時間が無駄である。
blocks.translation: Players immediately choose “Run” as soon as battle begins. If they are only going to run from battles, the time spent on the encounter sequence is wasted.

blocks.source: 同じザコ敵と何度も戦うため、戦闘に飽きやすい。
blocks.translation: Having to fight the same weak enemies repeatedly makes battles feel boring.

blocks.source: 歩くだけで疲れるため、マップを探索する意欲が起きない。
blocks.translation: Simply walking becomes tiring, so players lose the motivation to explore the map.

blocks.source: クリアまで進める気力がなくなるので、最後までシナリオを見てもらえない。
blocks.translation: Players lose the motivation to play through to the end, so they never get to see the entire scenario.

blocks.source: シナリオ重視・戦闘重視のどちらのプレイヤーにとっても、嫌がる要素が含まれていることに注目して頂きたい。
blocks.translation: Note that this includes elements disliked by both players who prioritize the scenario and those who prioritize battles.

blocks.source: シナリオ重視のＲＰＧなら、エンカウント率を低くしてテンポ良くした方がよいというのは、誰でも考えつくはず。しかし、
blocks.translation: Anyone would probably realize that an RPG focused on its scenario should have a low encounter rate to keep the pace brisk. However,

blocks.source: 実は戦闘重視のＲＰＧでもエンカウント率は低くてよい。
blocks.translation: in fact, even an RPG focused on battles can have a low encounter rate.

blocks.source: 戦闘に手応えを求めるならば、ザコ戦闘一回辺りの難易度を上げたりボス敵を強くすればよい。現にロマンシングサガ２以降のサガシリーズもそうなっていたりする。
blocks.translation: If you want battles to feel satisfying, you can increase the difficulty of each battle against weak enemies or make boss enemies stronger. In fact, this is how the SaGa series has been since Romancing SaGa 2.

blocks.source: 大抵の場合、エンカウント率が高すぎることによる弊害が大きい。なので、エンカウント率はやや低めを意識しておけば間違いはない。
blocks.translation: In most cases, the drawbacks of an encounter rate that is too high are significant. Therefore, you cannot go wrong if you aim for a slightly lower encounter rate.

blocks.source: エンカウント率が高すぎる作品の例
blocks.translation: Examples of Games with Excessively High Encounter Rates

blocks.source: 以下はエンカウント率が高いＲＰＧの例。どんなに他の要素が素晴らしくとも、これ一つが原因で、人にお勧めできないＲＰＧとなる場合も。
blocks.translation: The following are examples of RPGs with high encounter rates. No matter how excellent the other elements are, this one issue can make an RPG impossible to recommend to others.

blocks.source: ファイナルファンタジー４(SFC)
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy IV (SFC)

blocks.source: この中では、エンカウント率自体は比較的低いが、全体的にザコ敵が強いので、体感エンカウント率は高い。一応、簡単に逃げることができるが、所持金が減るペナルティがある。筆者は戦闘の半分以上は逃げていた。
blocks.translation: Among these examples, its actual encounter rate is relatively low, but the weak enemies are generally strong, so the perceived encounter rate is high. You can escape easily enough, but there is a penalty that reduces your money. I ran from more than half of the battles.

blocks.source: テイルズオブファンタジア(SFC)
blocks.translation: Tales of Phantasia (SFC)

blocks.source: ダッシュすると、エンカウント率が倍増するバグあり。ホーリーボトルを使用するとエンカウント率が低下するが、すぐ効果が切れるので、何度も使用するのが面倒くさい。
blocks.translation: There is a bug that doubles the encounter rate when you dash. Using a Holy Bottle lowers the encounter rate, but its effect wears off quickly, making it tedious to use repeatedly.

blocks.source: ラストバイブル３
blocks.translation: Last Bible III

blocks.source: 戦闘は悪魔との交渉によって回避できるが、エンカウント自体はするので面倒くさい。エストマの魔法で、敵の出現率が下がるが、消費が大きいし特定の仲魔を連れて行く必要がある。
blocks.translation: Battles can be avoided by negotiating with demons, but you still encounter them in the first place, which is tedious. The Estoma spell lowers the rate at which enemies appear, but it consumes a lot of MP and requires you to bring a specific demon ally.

blocks.source: スターオーシャン２
blocks.translation: Star Ocean: The Second Story

blocks.source: 気を抜くと、ザコ敵でも全滅する難易度と相まって非常に厳しい。エンカウント率が減少する装備なども存在するが、入手方法がやや分かり辛い。
blocks.translation: It is extremely harsh when combined with the difficulty, where even weak enemies can wipe out your party if you let your guard down. Equipment that reduces the encounter rate does exist, but how to obtain it is somewhat difficult to figure out.

blocks.source: ワイルドアームズ アルターコードＦ
blocks.translation: Wild Arms: Alter Code F

blocks.source: エンカウントキャンセルというシステムによって、不意打ちを除く戦闘をある程度避けることができるが、その不意打ち率が非常に高い。筆者の記憶では、後半の戦闘では、戦闘が不意打ちで始まる事の方が多かったような記憶すらある。当然、不意打ちだと最初の１ターンは一方的に攻撃されるわけで、プレイヤーの心象は悪い。
blocks.translation: The Encounter Cancel system lets you avoid battles to some extent, except for surprise attacks, but the rate of surprise attacks is extremely high. As I remember it, during the latter half of the game, I even felt that battles were more likely to begin with a surprise attack. Naturally, a surprise attack means being attacked unilaterally during the first turn, which leaves a bad impression on the player.

blocks.source: エストポリス伝記
blocks.translation: Estpolis Biography

blocks.source: ゲーム自体が全体的に地味だけど、加えてエンカウント率が高くテンポが悪い。お使いイベントの多さも相まって、筆者は途中で何度も投げたくなった。
blocks.translation: The game itself is rather unremarkable overall, and its high encounter rate makes the pacing even worse. Combined with the abundance of errands, it made me want to give up several times along the way.

blocks.source: ロマンシングサガ
blocks.translation: Romancing SaGa

blocks.source: シンボルエンカウントだが、過剰なまでに敵が多い。扉の向こうで行儀良く待ち構える、無数の敵を見た時はもう……。以降のシリーズ作品では大幅に改善。
blocks.translation: It uses symbol encounters, but there are an excessive number of enemies. When I saw the countless enemies waiting politely on the other side of a door, I was simply... The subsequent games in the series made major improvements.

blocks.source: 筆者はプレイしていないけど、大貝獣物語２辺りもエンカウント率の高さで台無しなゲームとして有名。ＦＣ・ＧＢ時代の大抵のＲＰＧも今やると、エンカウント率が高くて辛い。
blocks.translation: I have not played it, but Great Sea Story 2 is also famous as a game ruined by its high encounter rate. Most RPGs from the Famicom and Game Boy eras are also painful to play today because their encounter rates are so high.

blocks.source: エンカウント率の調整
blocks.translation: Adjusting the Encounter Rate

blocks.source: 目安として、「逃げる」を多用したくなるゲームはエンカウント率が高く、戦闘が面倒だと思われている場合が多い。
blocks.translation: As a rule of thumb, when players want to use “Run” frequently, the game often has a high encounter rate and battles are perceived as tedious.

blocks.source: 理想を言えば「逃げる」とは
blocks.translation: Ideally, “Run” should be used to

blocks.source: 勝てない強敵との戦闘から離脱する。
blocks.translation: Escape from battles against powerful enemies you cannot defeat.

blocks.source: ボス戦に備えて、戦力を温存する。
blocks.translation: Conserve your strength in preparation for a boss battle.

blocks.source: などの目的で使用されるのがよいと思う。これが戦闘が面倒臭いという理由で、多用されるのはよろしくない。
blocks.translation: I think it is best used for purposes such as these.

blocks.source: ＲＰＧによっては後半のダンジョン程、エンカウント率が高く設定されている場合もあるけれど、お勧めできない。後半のダンジョンは一般的に『長い』『仕掛けが複雑』『敵が強い』と三拍子揃っているため、その上でエンカウント率を上げると不快指数は跳ね上がる。
blocks.translation: Some RPGs have their encounter rates set higher in later dungeons, but I cannot recommend this. Later dungeons generally have all three of these traits: they are long, their gimmicks are complex, and their enemies are strong. Raising the encounter rate on top of that makes the frustration level skyrocket.

blocks.source: 調整法として、エンカウント率を下げる特技や道具も有効。
blocks.translation: Techs and items that lower the encounter rate are also effective as a way to adjust it.

blocks.source: ただし、あくまでこれは補助的な手段であり劇的な効果が得られるとは限らない。上記の作品の多くにもエンカウント率を低下させたり、戦闘から逃げるための手段が存在する。ただし、エンカウント率減少用のアイテムをイチイチ効果が切れるたびに、使用しなければならないなど、別のストレスが発生する場合がよく見られる。
blocks.translation: However, this is merely a supplementary measure and may not produce a dramatic effect. Many of the works mentioned above also provide ways to lower the encounter rate or escape from battles. However, it is often the case that this creates another source of stress, such as requiring the player to use an item that reduces the encounter rate every single time its effect wears off.

blocks.source: 結局は元々のエンカウント率を適切に調整することが何より。また、手段を用意してもそれにプレイヤーが気づかなければ意味がないので注意したい。
blocks.translation: Ultimately, the most important thing is to adjust the original encounter rate appropriately. Also, even if you provide players with a way to deal with it, that is meaningless if they do not notice it, so be careful.

blocks.source: 敵を避けることができるシンボルエンカウント制の導入も、ロマサガ１のように非常識に敵を配置しなければ有効な手段となる。
blocks.translation: Introducing a symbol encounter system that allows players to avoid enemies can also be an effective solution, as long as you do not place enemies in absurd numbers like in Romancing SaGa 1.

blocks.source: それにしても世の中には、なぜこれほどまでにエンカウント率が高いＲＰＧにあふれているのだろう？ ラストバイブル３なんてエンカウント率さえ、まともならば評価が一回り違っただろうに。何とももったいない。
blocks.translation: Even so, why is the world so full of RPGs with such high encounter rates? If only Last Bible 3 had had a reasonable encounter rate, its critical reception would have been completely different. What a waste.
